details.description: Llama 2 13B is the base, 13-billion-parameter pretrained model in Meta's Llama 2 family of auto-regressive transformer language models, trained on 2 trillion tokens of publicly available text between January and July 2023 with a pretraining data cutoff of September 2022, per Meta's model card. As a pretrained (non-chat) model it performs text completion on a prompt and can be adapted to a variety of natural language generation tasks, in contrast to the fine-tuned '-f' chat variant built for dialogue. Meta's Hugging Face organization now lists Llama 2 in a legacy 'History' section behind the current Llama 3.1, 3.2, 3.3 and 4 families.
advantages: Scores 54.8 on MMLU and averages 66.9 on Meta's grouped commonsense-reasoning benchmarks, per Meta's model card.
Reports 41.86% on TruthfulQA (percentage of truthful and informative generations), per Meta's model card.
disadvantages: Base pretrained model only, not instruction- or chat-tuned; Meta positions the fine-tuned '-f' chat variant for assistant-like dialogue.
Meta states intended use is commercial and research use in English, and that safety testing 'has not covered, nor could it cover, all scenarios.'
Superseded by later Llama generations: Meta's Hugging Face organization lists Llama 2 in a legacy 'History' section behind Llama 3.1, 3.2, 3.3 and 4.
Pretraining knowledge cutoff of September 2022, per Meta's model card.
use_cases: General-purpose text completion and natural language generation
Base checkpoint for further fine-tuning or research, per Meta's model card

sources.title: Llama 2 foundation models from Meta are now available in Amazon SageMaker JumpStart

notes: This is the SageMaker JumpStart artifact for the base (non-chat) Llama 2 13B pretrained model; the AWS launch blog confirms 'meta-textgeneration-llama-2-13b' is the pretrained/completion id (paired chat id 'meta-textgeneration-llama-2-13b-f'), matching the catalog's /v1/completions endpoint. Benchmark table on the Hugging Face model card is shared verbatim across all Llama 2 HF repos (base and chat); only the pretrained-model rows (MMLU, TruthfulQA) are used here since they are not repeated for the chat-tuned variant. Catalog's 4096/4096 token limits match Meta's stated 4,096-token context.
